text:
Priya: Quick sync — we need to lock landing copy for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages ahead of the webinar. Goal: aligned benchmark narrative, launch posts, and inbound lead routing. 3 asks: headlines, webinar hooks mapped to each page, and exact form routing. Can we lock by EOD Thu?
Sam: +1. I can run a quick hero A/B test. Do we want to lead with performance numbers or price predictability? :thinking_face:?
Diego: Ops/product POV: prioritize predictable latency claim (p50/p95) in hero, benchmarks in a callout below. Performance numbers OK as long as we use ranges (e.g., ~2k tokens/s) not hard guarantees.
Emma: I'll draft 3 headline variants per mode this afternoon. Quick ideas: Hosted: "Ship features fast with Redwood Hosted API"; Dedicated: "Predictable throughput, reserved for you"; Private: "Run inference behind your VPC" — will make them snappier.
Priya: Love it. Also need short webinar hooks per mode (one-liners to use in social posts + slide CTAs). Example: Hosted -> "Get started in minutes — demo + live Q&A"; Dedicated -> "Throughput at scale — ops panel"; Private -> "Compliance & isolation — enterprise track".
Sam: For the landing A/B, I'll test microcopy variants: "Start free" vs "Request capacity" vs "Talk to sales" as CTA depending on mode. Need final CTAs by Wed 1pm to wire tests.
Emma: Pushing a routing map for the webinar form — please review:
```
source=webinar
form_field=hosting_choice
if hosting_choice == "Hosted": tag=hosted_trial; assign=pre-sales
elif hosting_choice == "Dedicated": tag=dedicated_inbound; assign=sales_engineering
elif hosting_choice == "Private": tag=private_enterprise; assign=enterprise_sales
else: tag=general_inbound; assign=growth
```
Diego: Minor tweak: Dedicated should also set "qualification=high" if team_size > 50 or committed_gpu > 4. Also add UTM requirement for tracking.
Priya: Good catch. Sam — can you ensure tracking fields flow into the CRM? We want utm_campaign=tri_launch, utm_source=webinar, utm_content=[hosted|dedicated|private].
Sam: Yep — wiring that now. I'll also add a hidden field for "benchmark_interest" so we can tag folks who click the benchmark CTA.
Emma: Drafting the benchmark callout language: "Real-world throughput: ~2k tokens/s on A100; p50 latency < 10ms for 1k-token workloads." Thoughts?
Diego: Sounds fine. Change to "~2k tokens/sec" and remove exact p50 number — say "low double-digit ms p50" to stay conservative.
Emma: Updated: "Real-world: ~2k tokens/sec on A100; low double-digit ms p50 for 1k-token workloads." I'll add a small tooltip explaining test setup.
Priya: Webinar plan: breakout rooms split by mode with one micro-demo each. Slide 3 should include anchors to the specific landing sections and specific UTMs. Also prepare 1-page summary for AE team with routing rules.
Emma: I'll create the AE one-pager and upload copy + variant screenshots here: https://drive.redwood/marketing/tri-mode-launch/v1 — ping when uploaded.
Sam: I set up two hero variants on staging. Emma, can you drop final H1 + CTA into the staging doc by Wed 1pm?
Emma: Will do. Also adding short social copy for launch posts + webinar blurb. Sample post: "Join our launch webinar — see how Hosted, Dedicated, and Private modes trade off cost, latency, and control. Register -> link"
Priya: Solid. Last ask: can Nora-bot (event bot) create calendar events with CTAs linking to the right anchored landing pages after Emma uploads?
Nora-bot: scheduled reminder set for Wed 11:00 to review final copy. :white_check_mark:
Sam: OK — locking deadlines: Emma Wed 1pm for copy, Diego confirm benchmarks by Wed 5pm, Sam wires UTMs and tests by Thu morning, Priya final sign-off by EOD Thu.
Priya: Perfect. Thanks everyone — let's keep copy tight and measurable. :thumbsup:
